# Test Issues Checklist — {feature/epic name}

- **template_id**: test-issues-checklist-template.md
- **run_id**: {run_id}
- **node_id**: plan
- **status**: draft

## Test level issues (required)
- [ ] Test strategy issue
- [ ] Unit test issues
- [ ] Integration test issues
- [ ] End-to-end test issues
- [ ] Performance test issues
- [ ] Security test issues
- [ ] Accessibility test issues
- [ ] Regression test issues

## Coverage targets & metrics (required)
- [ ] Code coverage: >80% line, >90% branch on critical paths
- [ ] Functional coverage: 100% acceptance criteria
- [ ] Risk coverage: 100% high-risk scenarios
- [ ] ISO 25010 characteristics coverage

## Task breakdown & estimation (required)
- [ ] Test tasks created with Fibonacci estimates
- [ ] Dependencies & critical path identified

## Traceability (required)
| Test issue | REQ | US | UNIT | TEST |
|------------|-----|----|------|------|
